facts.statement: SEBI Grade A Phase 1 (qualifying): Paper 1 is 80 MCQs, 100 marks, 60 minutes with General Awareness 20 questions/25 marks, English 20/25, Quantitative Aptitude 20/25 and Reasoning 20/25, cut-off 30% with no sectional cut-off and negative marking one-quarter (0.3125 per wrong); Paper 2 (General stream) is 50 MCQs, 100 marks, 40 minutes pooling Commerce & Accountancy, Management, Finance, Costing, Companies Act and Economics, cut-off 40% with negative 0.5; aggregate cut-off 40%.

SEBI Grade A Phase 2: Paper 1 descriptive is 100 marks in 60 minutes with cut-off 30% - Essay (choose 1 of 4 topics, 250-270 words, 30 marks), Precis (140-160 words with title, 30 marks) and Reading Comprehension (5 questions, 40 marks); a Letter Writing component appears in the 2025 table of contents. Paper 2 is objective, 100 marks, 90 minutes, cut-off 40%, with 100 questions at 1 mark each from 2024 (previously 50 questions at 2 marks in 2022). Aggregate cut-off 50%; Paper 1 contributes one-third and Paper 2 two-thirds; final selection is Phase 2 85% plus interview 15%.

SEBI quant themes: Data Interpretation dominates (about 50% of questions in 2024) with wrong-term number series, quadratic equations, boats and streams, mixture/alligation, profit and loss and CI/SI; Partnership, Time-and-Work and Simple Interest did not appear in 2024 despite historical importance.

SEBI reasoning: seating arrangements and puzzles dominated (12 of 20 in 2024) plus blood relations, alphanumeric/alphabetical series, coding-decoding, syllogism, direction sense and inequality. English: RC 7 questions in 2024 (down from 10 in 2022), error detection, fill-ups, para-jumbles; vocabulary/cloze variable. GA: government schemes (SEBI-centric), finance static awareness, sports, awards, first-in-news, science and tech, days-in-news, defence and banking/economy current affairs over a 3-8 month window; SEBI-specific items (REITs, CDSL, DRHP) recur.

SEBI stream themes: Finance - bonds/debt markets highest weight (2024 Phase 1), equity, financial institutions, derivatives, SEBI functions, financial inclusion, FRBM, time value of money, forex; Phase 2 adds risk management, budget and taxation. Management - Theory Z, Victor Vroom, leadership styles, Maslow/Herzberg, communication. Commerce - ratios, cash/fund flow, AS-2/AS-10/revenue recognition/FX, share capital (bonus/rights/buyback/ESOP), final accounts. Costing - marginal costing highest, standard costing/variance, lean systems (JIT, Kaizen, 5S, TPM, Six Sigma, BPR), methods of costing, budgets. Companies Act - Chapter IV highest (3-4 questions), XXVII (NCLT/NCLAT), VIII dividends, XI directors, XII board meetings, X audit, III prospectus. Economics - Phillips curve/inflation top-weighted, national income, demand and supply, IS-LM, monetary/fiscal policy, balance of payments, business cycles, market structures.

SEBI descriptive themes: essays span ESG/sustainability, management/culture, healthcare/banking, technology/AI, social media/politics, quick commerce, transport infrastructure and global Indian leadership; precis passages are sourced from LiveMint, The Hindu, Economic Times and Forbes; RC passages cover contemporary socio-economic and technology topics.

SEBI guidebook strategy: a 300-hour study plan (Management 40, Costing 40, Finance 40, Company Law 40, GA 30, Revision 30, Accounts 20, Economics 20, Quant 20, Reasoning 20); full-length mocks only after 70-80% syllabus coverage with 5 mocks recommended and a 1-day analysis gap; daily recall plus a 1-1-1 revision rule (daily, weekly, monthly); PYQ-driven selective reading instead of cover-to-cover textbooks.
SEBI General-stream Phase 2 final cut-offs: 69.24 (2020), 64.82 (2022) and 69.30 (2024); the 2024 increase followed the doubling of Phase 2 Paper 2 questions from 50 to 100.
